paper_safe_statement: After adding the implemented lazy-valid bitmap, the W384 combined descriptor-plus-signed24-accumulator lower bound is 909736 bytes; the frozen 2.535462x figure remains a same-clock precompacted service-island software projection, with standalone controller, accumulator and lane adapter passing commercial VCS but no integrated replay or macro-inclusive PPA.
